reproduction.before_implementation_inspection: Native Bearing edit panel: selecting direct Part::Cylinder Face1 succeeds; selecting the App::Link occurrence Face1 exits139 repeatedly. Durable marker before the synchronous Selection.addSelection call exists and the after marker does not. No building document, solver, or engineering data used.
reproduction.additional_baseline: Gear reference selection also crashes in the inherited Bearing callback. PlaneRotation safely rejects the link with a selection warning. Transform initially needs analysis membership to open; the valid-analysis control was used for subsequent qualification.

cause: Bearing and Gear selection callbacks assumed every selected owner was Part::Feature. App::Link violates that assumption. Bearing also processed derived-panel selection modes before the derived callback could handle them.
fix: Bearing resolves selected reference/location geometry through the existing occurrence-aware Fem::Tools helper, checks null/topological type before OCCT conversion, preserves the original selected owner and subname, and only processes its own selection modes. Gear/Pulley Direction explicitly rejects non-Part owners because the native direction consumer does not support links; valid direct Part directions remain supported.

audit.Bearing_Gear_Pulley_references_and_locat: Native selection callbacks accept placed linked geometry without crashing or substituting its source owner.
audit.Gear_Pulley_direction: Linked direction owner rejected with explicit warning, direct planar Part accepted. No new linked Direction capability claimed.
audit.PlaneRotation_Transform: Existing isObjectTypeOf guard checks the actual owner type before the static cast. Native Add selection safely rejects links; direct-Part controls accepted. Transform control includes a force boundary and analysis membership.
audit.FluidBoundary_direction: Existing actual-owner type guard safely rejects links. Native inlet/uniformVelocity direction button qualified, with direct planar Part control accepted.
audit.command_helper: The Part::Feature cast in Command.cpp belongs to the commented-out, unregistered CmdFemAddPart implementation, not a reachable current GUI command. No command implementation changed.
audit.remaining_specialized_static_casts: The three active remaining Part::Feature casts are preceded by actual-owner type guards. SelectionObject::isObjectTypeOf checks getObject()->isDerivedFrom, not the linked source type.

verification.native_scope: Bearing/Gear/Pulley occurrence reference and Location callbacks, original owner retention, enclosing rotated/translated parent placement, Undo/Redo, saved FCStd cold reopen before target recompute, ordinary parent movement/recompute, unresolved owner and wrong topology rejection, Gear/Pulley linked direction rejection and direct controls, guarded PlaneRotation/Transform/FluidBoundary rejection and direct controls.
verification.lint: New Python GUI test passes flake8 --ignore=E266,W503 --max-line-length=100. Changed C++ lines pass git-clang-format. git diff --check passes.
verification.review: Main-agent review of callback modes, null/topology checks, inherited Gear/Pulley dispatch, guarded remaining casts and selection-owner semantics; no delegated review claimed.

installation: No install command or replacement performed. /Applications/FreeCAD-27.1.0.app remains unchanged; this source build still requires the repository Pixi dependency environment.
